items.question: Who is devoted to service of guru-deva-great-souls?
premises: The verse names the devoted one.
items.inference: The verse identifies the service-devoted disciple of guru-deva-great-souls.
items.plain_english: He who is devoted to service of the guru, deva, and great souls.
